outline:
讓學生學習細菌培養與噬菌體萃取，再將噬菌體與生物醫學材料結合，做出具抗菌能力之生物相容材料，或可檢測細菌之探針。培養學生獨立自主探討一個理論或技術上的問題，並經由實驗設計及資料之判讀更深入專業領域。
Students will learn bacterial culture and bacteriophage purification. They will combine bacteriophage with different biomaterials to make antibacterial biocompatable materials or precise bacteria detection tool. An independent research capability can be developed through out this learning process.

3-5 Bacterial culture

9-11 Bacteriphage characterization
12-14 Produce phage-material complex and perform relevant tests
15-18 Data analysis and report writing
